mechanics.name: Genuine Top-Down Mario Jumping
mechanics.controls: Press L or R shoulder button (hold for full ~22px parabolic arc; release early for short-hop)
mechanics.physics: 8.8 fixed-point Z height ($F501:$F502), initial VZ = +2.56 px/frame (0x0290), gravity = -0.14 px/frame^2 (0x0024), max fall = -3.0 px/frame, 4-frame landing cooldown
mechanics.rendering: Applies altitude to native ALTTP $24/$25 post-Link_Main so Bank $0D renders Mario cleanly above his dark oval ground shadow while preserving full 8-direction movement & wall collision
mechanics.sfx: Native SPC700 SMW rising jump sweep (SFX2 0x20)
mechanics.verification: Unit-tested + Live visually verified in Mednafen snes_faust & bsnes (shadow clearly visible beneath mid-air Mario)

mechanics.name: Genuine Mario Stomp Combat
mechanics.controls: Descend from a Mario Jump (MARIO_AIRBORNE == 2, Z in 1..21px) onto a stompable enemy
mechanics.vulnerability_table: $22:9800 (256 bytes): 0x00=NPC/Boss/Immune, 0x01=Stompable (Koopas, Goombas, Buzzies, Rex, Monty Moles, Dry Bones, Cheep Cheeps), 0x02=Spiked (Spinies, Thwomps, Chain Chomps — immune to ordinary stomp, defeated by Starman)
mechanics.effects: Deals 6 HP stomp damage or instant defeat puff ($0DD0=6), awards +1 Gold Coin ($7E:F362), plays native SPC700 Mario Stomp Pop (SFX3 0x08), grants 18 frames post-stomp i-frames, bounces Mario upward (higher bounce when holding L/R!)
mechanics.verification: Unit-tested + Live visually verified in Mednafen snes_faust (16_mario_jump_stomp.png: Mario descends onto Blue Koopa Troopa -> 4-sparkle defeat puff -> upward bounce -> zero damage -> coin counter 153 -> 154 -> Red Mini-Mushroom drop)

mechanics.name: Super Mario Hammer (Sword Elimination)
mechanics.controls: Press B button for Mario Super Hammer strike
mechanics.assets: Replaced all melee sword swing frames and File Select sword in raw 0xCF, Start Menu EQUIPEMENT Lv1..Lv4 weapons (0x06F769), and native SPC700 Hammer Bonk SFX (SFX1 0x01/0x02)
mechanics.verification: Live visually verified in File Select, Start Menu, and Overworld gameplay

mechanics.name: Fire Mario Live CGRAM Transformation
mechanics.controls: Equip FLEUR DE FEU ($7E:0202 == 0x06) and press Y to throw Fireballs
mechanics.effects: Live-swaps Mario's CGRAM OBJ palette ($7E:C6E2..$7E:C6FF + $15=1) to pure white cap/shirt & blazing crimson overalls; restores Classic Mario Red/Blue automatically when unequipped
mechanics.verification: Unit-tested + Live visually verified in Mednafen snes_faust & bsnes

mechanics.name: Super Starman Invincibility
mechanics.controls: Press L + R simultaneously (consumes 0x20 Star Power from $7E:F36E)
mechanics.effects: 240 frames (4 seconds) of 4-palette rainbow CGRAM flashing (Gold/Cyan/Neon Green/Magenta), full damage immunity ($037B=1), instant contact-kill on both stompable and spiked enemies, and crisp Mario Star/Coin chime (SFX2 0x2B)
mechanics.verification: Unit-tested + Live visually verified in Mednafen snes_faust & bsnes
